<!-- PUBLICATION NOTES
  WORKING DIRECTORY: Open aqua_traits.Rproj in this folder (File > Open Project),
  or setwd() to this folder, before running. All paths below are relative.
  INPUTS:
    - fao_data.csv          (~54 MB; FAO global production extract)
    - fao_spp_code.csv      (FAO species code / taxonomy list)
  Data downloaded September 29, 2023 from:
  https://www.fao.org/fishery/statistics-query/en/global_production/global_production_quantity
  OUTPUTS written here: species.csv, species_x_country.csv, volume.csv
-->

Data downloaded September 29, 2023 from https://www.fao.org/fishery/statistics-query/en/global_production/global_production_quantity

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)

```

```{r read in and format data}

# INPUTS: relative to project folder — change only if files live elsewhere
data<-read.csv("fao_data.csv")
head(data)

# FAO species list; rename code column to match fao_data join key
spp<-read.csv("fao_spp_code.csv")
spp<-spp %>% rename(SPECIES.ALPHA_3_CODE = X3A_Code)

data<-subset(data, PRODUCTION_SOURCE_DET.CODE!="CAPTURE") #remove all capture
unique(data$PRODUCTION_SOURCE_DET.CODE) #check
data<-subset(data, PRODUCTION_SOURCE_DET.CODE=="MARINE") #only keep marine species
unique(data$PRODUCTION_SOURCE_DET.CODE) #check
unique(data$SPECIES.ALPHA_3_CODE)

dat<-full_join(data, spp, by="SPECIES.ALPHA_3_CODE") #31747 
dat<-subset(dat, Major_Group=="PLANTAE AQUATICAE") #only aquatic plants, 3655
dat<-subset(dat, PRODUCTION_SOURCE_DET.CODE=="MARINE") #marine only, 3392
species<-as.data.frame(unique(dat$Scientific_Name))

write.table(species, "species.csv", col.names = T, sep=",")


species_x_country<-as.data.frame(table(dat$Scientific_Name, dat$COUNTRY.UN_CODE))

species_x_country<-subset(species_x_country, Freq>0)

write.table(species_x_country, "species_x_country.csv", col.names=T, sep=",")


volume<-subset(dat, PERIOD==2021)

write.table(volume, "volume.csv", col.names=T, sep=",")
```
